title: Fixed Points, Stability, Basin Geometry, and Global Convergence of the $3\times3$ Correlation Map
summary: For more than half a century, iterated Pearson correlation has underpinned methods for network blockmodeling, clustering, seriation, and information visualization. Despite its continued use and the longstanding assumption of convergence, the global convergence problem remained open even in dimension three. We resolve this problem completely for the $3\times3$ correlation map: every admissible orbit is well defined for all forward iterates and converges to one of exactly seven fixed points.
